rust_declaration.name: dedup

trusted_assumptions: The declared lower-level Vec::<T, A>::dedup_by assume_specification: for a universally callable, non-mutating callback compatible with a fold step, the final Vec view is that fold.
vstd::std_specs::cmp::PartialEqSpec links T::eq to eq_spec under T::obeys_eq_spec().
rationale: The source preserves the sole Vec::dedup_by call and mechanically inlines the &mut PartialEq forwarding used by a == b. The equality closure satisfies the lower fold contract.
